meaning: Each key is the exact message of a database guard (RAISE EXCEPTION in migrations/). A refusal whose guard message is a key here is answered with this stable code and these sentences; any other refusal keeps the module's general conflict answer. Codes are stable API: never rename one, add a new entry instead.

A company that already trades in IDR can.message: This company already has products, orders or invoices in IDR, so its book cannot be opened in another currency. Open the book in IDR, or create a new company for trading in the other currency.
A company that already trades in IDR can.message_id: Perusahaan ini sudah punya produk, pesanan, atau faktur dalam IDR, jadi pembukuannya tidak bisa dibuka dengan mata uang lain. Buka pembukuan dalam IDR, atau buat perusahaan baru untuk bertransaksi dengan mata uang lain.

Currency differs from the company book.message: This record's currency is not the currency of the company's book. Use the book's currency (IDR when the company has no book yet) and try again.
Currency differs from the company book.message_id: Mata uang catatan ini berbeda dengan mata uang pembukuan perusahaan. Gunakan mata uang pembukuan (IDR jika perusahaan belum punya pembukuan), lalu coba lagi.

Sales line is priced in another currency.message: This product is priced in a different currency than the sales order. Choose a product that belongs to the same company and currency as the order.
Sales line is priced in another currency.message_id: Produk ini dihargai dalam mata uang yang berbeda dengan pesanan penjualan. Pilih produk dari perusahaan dan mata uang yang sama dengan pesanan.

Offer is priced in another currency than.message: A supplier offer must be priced in the same currency as its product. Enter the offer in the product's currency.
Offer is priced in another currency than.message_id: Penawaran pemasok harus memakai mata uang yang sama dengan produknya. Masukkan penawaran dalam mata uang produk tersebut.

Purchase line is priced in another curre.message: This product or supplier offer is priced in a different currency than the purchase order. Choose a product and offer in the order's currency.
Purchase line is priced in another curre.message_id: Produk atau penawaran pemasok ini memakai mata uang yang berbeda dengan pesanan pembelian. Pilih produk dan penawaran dengan mata uang yang sama dengan pesanan.

Invoice currency differs from its compan.message: This invoice is in a different currency than the company's book, so it cannot be recorded in the accounts. Issue the invoice in the book's currency.
Invoice currency differs from its compan.message_id: Faktur ini memakai mata uang yang berbeda dengan pembukuan perusahaan, sehingga tidak bisa dicatat di akuntansi. Terbitkan faktur dalam mata uang pembukuan.

Sales order currency differs from its co.message: This sales order is in a different currency than the company's book, so its stock cost cannot be recorded in the accounts. Recreate the order in the book's currency.
Sales order currency differs from its co.message_id: Pesanan penjualan ini memakai mata uang yang berbeda dengan pembukuan perusahaan, sehingga biaya stoknya tidak bisa dicatat di akuntansi. Buat ulang pesanan dalam mata uang pembukuan.

Purchase order currency differs from its.message: This purchase order is in a different currency than the company's book, so it cannot be recorded in the accounts. Recreate the purchase order in the book's currency.
Purchase order currency differs from its.message_id: Pesanan pembelian ini memakai mata uang yang berbeda dengan pembukuan perusahaan, sehingga tidak bisa dicatat di akuntansi. Buat ulang pesanan pembelian dalam mata uang pembukuan.

This source bridge requires a reviewed n.message: The posting policy's amount unit does not fit this book. Use whole rupiah (whole_idr) for an IDR book and minor units (minor) for a book in any other currency, and make sure the book is a native book.
This source bridge requires a reviewed n.message_id: Satuan nominal pada kebijakan posting tidak sesuai dengan pembukuan ini. Gunakan rupiah utuh (whole_idr) untuk pembukuan IDR dan satuan minor (minor) untuk pembukuan mata uang lain, serta pastikan pembukuannya adalah pembukuan native.

Stock policy requires a reviewed native.message: The stock posting policy was refused. Use whole rupiah (whole_idr) for an IDR book or minor units (minor) for any other currency, and choose an active cost of goods sold account at its current revision.
Stock policy requires a reviewed native.message_id: Kebijakan posting stok ditolak. Gunakan rupiah utuh (whole_idr) untuk pembukuan IDR atau satuan minor (minor) untuk mata uang lain, dan pilih akun harga pokok penjualan yang aktif pada revisi terbarunya.

Invoice posting policy has no reviewed s.message: The invoice posting policy for this book has no reviewed amount unit, so the invoice cannot be recorded. Save a new revision of the invoice posting policy, then try again.
Invoice posting policy has no reviewed s.message_id: Kebijakan posting faktur untuk pembukuan ini belum punya satuan nominal yang ditinjau, sehingga faktur tidak bisa dicatat. Simpan revisi baru kebijakan posting faktur, lalu coba lagi.

Purchase source has no origin with a rev.message: The purchase posting policy for this book has no reviewed amount unit, so the purchase cannot be recorded. Save a new revision of the purchase posting policy, then try again.
Purchase source has no origin with a rev.message_id: Kebijakan posting pembelian untuk pembukuan ini belum punya satuan nominal yang ditinjau, sehingga pembelian tidak bisa dicatat. Simpan revisi baru kebijakan posting pembelian, lalu coba lagi.

Policy identity and unit basis are immut.message: A posting policy's book and amount unit cannot be changed after it is created, and each change must build on its latest revision. Refresh the policy and revise only its accounts.
Policy identity and unit basis are immut.message_id: Pembukuan dan satuan nominal pada kebijakan posting tidak bisa diubah setelah dibuat, dan setiap perubahan harus berdasarkan revisi terbarunya. Muat ulang kebijakan dan revisi hanya akun-akunnya.

Stock policy identity and unit basis are.message: A stock posting policy's book and amount unit cannot be changed after it is created, and each change must build on its latest revision. Refresh the policy and revise only its cost of goods sold account.
Stock policy identity and unit basis are.message_id: Pembukuan dan satuan nominal pada kebijakan posting stok tidak bisa diubah setelah dibuat, dan setiap perubahan harus berdasarkan revisi terbarunya. Muat ulang kebijakan dan revisi hanya akun harga pokok penjualannya.

Three distinct source roles/accounts are.message: The invoice posting policy needs three different accounts, one for each role. Choose a separate account for each role and save again.
Three distinct source roles/accounts are.message_id: Kebijakan posting faktur membutuhkan tiga akun yang berbeda, satu untuk tiap peran. Pilih akun terpisah untuk setiap peran, lalu simpan lagi.

Four distinct source roles/accounts are.message: The purchase posting policy needs four different accounts, one for each role. Choose a separate account for each role and save again.
Four distinct source roles/accounts are.message_id: Kebijakan posting pembelian membutuhkan empat akun yang berbeda, satu untuk tiap peran. Pilih akun terpisah untuk setiap peran, lalu simpan lagi.

A source account differs from its review.message: One of the accounts in this posting policy is inactive, has changed since you reviewed it, or is the wrong type for its role. Refresh the chart of accounts and choose a current account of the right type.
A source account differs from its review.message_id: Salah satu akun pada kebijakan posting ini tidak aktif, sudah berubah sejak Anda tinjau, atau jenisnya tidak cocok dengan perannya. Muat ulang daftar akun dan pilih akun terbaru dengan jenis yang sesuai.

An existing native book is required.message: This action needs a native book that already exists for the company. Create the company's book first, or choose a company that has one.
An existing native book is required.message_id: Tindakan ini membutuhkan pembukuan native yang sudah ada untuk perusahaan. Buat pembukuan perusahaan terlebih dahulu, atau pilih perusahaan yang sudah punya pembukuan.

An opening balance must use the control.message: The opening balance names a different control account than the one the current posting policy declares. Use the receivable, payable or inventory account from the current posting policy, or set that policy first.
An opening balance must use the control.message_id: Saldo awal memakai akun kontrol yang berbeda dengan yang ditetapkan kebijakan posting saat ini. Gunakan akun piutang, utang, atau persediaan dari kebijakan posting yang berlaku, atau atur kebijakan itu terlebih dahulu.

An opening balance needs an active contr.message: The opening balance needs an active control account of the right type and an active equity account as its offset. Choose an active equity account for the offset and check that the control account is active.
An opening balance needs an active contr.message_id: Saldo awal membutuhkan akun kontrol aktif dengan jenis yang sesuai dan akun ekuitas aktif sebagai lawannya. Pilih akun ekuitas yang aktif sebagai lawan dan pastikan akun kontrolnya aktif.

Opening lines differ from the declared a.message: The opening balance journal no longer matches its declared accounts or amount. Refresh the accounts and enter the opening balance again.
Opening lines differ from the declared a.message_id: Jurnal saldo awal tidak lagi cocok dengan akun atau jumlah yang dinyatakan. Muat ulang daftar akun dan masukkan saldo awal sekali lagi.

Reserved opening references require a de.message: Journal references starting with "opening:" are reserved for opening balances. Use the opening balance action, or choose a different reference for this journal.
Reserved opening references require a de.message_id: Referensi jurnal yang diawali "opening:" khusus untuk saldo awal. Gunakan tindakan saldo awal, atau pilih referensi lain untuk jurnal ini.

Resolve draft journals before closing.message: This period still has draft journals. Post or void every draft journal dated in the period, then close it.
Resolve draft journals before closing.message_id: Periode ini masih punya jurnal draf. Posting atau batalkan semua jurnal draf bertanggal dalam periode ini, lalu tutup periodenya.

Resolve unposted invoice sources before.message: This period still has invoices that are not posted to the ledger. Post the invoice sources dated in the period, then close it.
Resolve unposted invoice sources before.message_id: Periode ini masih punya faktur yang belum diposting ke buku besar. Posting sumber faktur bertanggal dalam periode ini, lalu tutup periodenya.

Resolve unposted receipt, supplier claim.message: This period still has goods receipts, supplier bills or purchase corrections that are not posted to the ledger. Post the purchase sources dated in the period, then close it.
Resolve unposted receipt, supplier claim.message_id: Periode ini masih punya penerimaan barang, tagihan pemasok, atau koreksi pembelian yang belum diposting ke buku besar. Posting sumber pembelian bertanggal dalam periode ini, lalu tutup periodenya.

Resolve unposted stock cost sources befo.message: This period still has stock costs that are not posted to the ledger. Post the stock cost sources dated in the period, then close it.
Resolve unposted stock cost sources befo.message_id: Periode ini masih punya biaya stok yang belum diposting ke buku besar. Posting sumber biaya stok bertanggal dalam periode ini, lalu tutup periodenya.

Resolve unmatched imported statement amo.message: This period still has imported bank statement amounts that are not matched. Match every statement row dated in the period, then close it.
Resolve unmatched imported statement amo.message_id: Periode ini masih punya nominal rekening koran impor yang belum dicocokkan. Cocokkan semua baris rekening koran bertanggal dalam periode ini, lalu tutup periodenya.

Configure an explicit reconciliation ope.message: At least one registered bank account has no reconciliation opening basis. Set an opening basis for every bank account, then close the period.
Configure an explicit reconciliation ope.message_id: Setidaknya satu rekening bank terdaftar belum punya dasar pembukaan rekonsiliasi. Atur dasar pembukaan untuk setiap rekening bank, lalu tutup periodenya.

Complete bank coverage, cash controls an.message: The bank reconciliation for this period is incomplete or was reviewed before the latest changes. Import the full statement, resolve the differences and have the reconciliation reviewed again, then close the period.
Complete bank coverage, cash controls an.message_id: Rekonsiliasi bank untuk periode ini belum lengkap atau ditinjau sebelum perubahan terakhir. Impor rekening koran secara lengkap, selesaikan selisihnya, dan minta rekonsiliasi ditinjau ulang, lalu tutup periodenya.

An open native book period is required.message: The journal date does not fall in an open period of this book. Choose a date inside an open period, open a period that covers the date, or reopen the closed period first.
An open native book period is required.message_id: Tanggal jurnal tidak berada dalam periode yang terbuka pada pembukuan ini. Pilih tanggal di dalam periode terbuka, buka periode yang mencakup tanggal itu, atau buka kembali periode yang sudah ditutup.

Stock source falls in a closed financial.message: This stock movement is dated in a financial period that is already closed, so its cost cannot be recorded. Reopen the period first, or wait until the stock movement falls in an open period.
Stock source falls in a closed financial.message_id: Pergerakan stok ini bertanggal dalam periode keuangan yang sudah ditutup, sehingga biayanya tidak bisa dicatat. Buka kembali periodenya terlebih dahulu, atau lakukan saat pergerakan stok jatuh dalam periode yang terbuka.

Reopen the financial source period befor.message: This invoice belongs to a financial period that is already closed. Reopen the period before changing the invoice.
Reopen the financial source period befor.message_id: Faktur ini termasuk dalam periode keuangan yang sudah ditutup. Buka kembali periodenya sebelum mengubah faktur.

Reopen the financial source period befor.message: This purchase belongs to a financial period that is already closed. Reopen the period before changing the purchase.
Reopen the financial source period befor.message_id: Pembelian ini termasuk dalam periode keuangan yang sudah ditutup. Buka kembali periodenya sebelum mengubah pembelian.

Reopen the statement and journal periods.message: This bank match touches a statement row or journal in a closed period. Reopen those periods before changing the match.
Reopen the statement and journal periods.message_id: Pencocokan bank ini menyangkut baris rekening koran atau jurnal dalam periode yang sudah ditutup. Buka kembali periode tersebut sebelum mengubah pencocokan.

Statement rows cannot be appended after.message: This bank statement covers a financial period that is already closed. Reopen the period before importing more statement rows for it.
Statement rows cannot be appended after.message_id: Rekening koran ini mencakup periode keuangan yang sudah ditutup. Buka kembali periodenya sebelum mengimpor baris rekening koran tambahan.

Reopen affected reconciled later periods.message: This cash posting is dated before a period that has already been reconciled with the bank. Reopen the affected later periods first, or use a later date.
Reopen affected reconciled later periods.message_id: Posting kas ini bertanggal sebelum periode yang sudah direkonsiliasi dengan bank. Buka kembali periode-periode setelahnya terlebih dahulu, atau gunakan tanggal yang lebih baru.

Period overlaps or has invalid initial s.message: The new period overlaps an existing period of this book. Choose dates that do not overlap any other period.
Period overlaps or has invalid initial s.message_id: Periode baru bertumpang tindih dengan periode lain pada pembukuan ini. Pilih tanggal yang tidak bertumpang tindih dengan periode mana pun.

Journal lines must be balanced, complete.message: The journal cannot be posted: it needs between 2 and 100 lines, and total debit must equal total credit. Correct the lines and try again.
Journal lines must be balanced, complete.message_id: Jurnal tidak bisa diposting: jurnal harus berisi 2 sampai 100 baris, dan total debit harus sama dengan total kredit. Perbaiki baris jurnal lalu coba lagi.

Journal cannot be amended; use a reversa.message: A posted or voided journal cannot be changed. Record a reversal of the journal and enter a corrected one.
Journal cannot be amended; use a reversa.message_id: Jurnal yang sudah diposting atau dibatalkan tidak bisa diubah. Buat jurnal pembalik, lalu masukkan jurnal yang benar.

Independent posting is required.message: This book requires a journal to be posted by someone other than the person who drafted it. Ask another authorised person to post this journal.
Independent posting is required.message_id: Pembukuan ini mewajibkan jurnal diposting oleh orang yang berbeda dari pembuat drafnya. Minta orang lain yang berwenang untuk memposting jurnal ini.

The bank evidence importer cannot be its.message: The person who imported the bank statement cannot also review its reconciliation. Ask another authorised person to review it.
The bank evidence importer cannot be its.message_id: Orang yang mengimpor rekening koran tidak boleh sekaligus meninjau rekonsiliasinya. Minta orang lain yang berwenang untuk meninjaunya.

Statement windows must not overlap.message: This bank statement's dates overlap a statement that was already imported for the same bank account. Import a statement whose dates start after the previous one ends.
Statement windows must not overlap.message_id: Tanggal rekening koran ini bertumpang tindih dengan rekening koran yang sudah diimpor untuk rekening bank yang sama. Impor rekening koran yang tanggalnya dimulai setelah rekening koran sebelumnya berakhir.

Adjacent statement closing and opening b.message: This statement's opening balance does not equal the closing balance of the statement before it (or its closing balance does not equal the opening balance of the next one). Check the statement and its balances, then import it again.
Adjacent statement closing and opening b.message_id: Saldo awal rekening koran ini tidak sama dengan saldo akhir rekening koran sebelumnya (atau saldo akhirnya tidak sama dengan saldo awal rekening koran berikutnya). Periksa rekening koran dan saldonya, lalu impor ulang.

Payment exceeds the current posted bill.message: The supplier bill changed, or this payment is larger than what is still owed on it counting payments already drafted. Refresh the bill and enter an amount up to its outstanding balance.
Payment exceeds the current posted bill.message_id: Tagihan pemasok sudah berubah, atau pembayaran ini melebihi sisa tagihan termasuk pembayaran lain yang sudah dibuat drafnya. Muat ulang tagihan dan masukkan jumlah paling banyak sebesar sisa tagihan.

Bank evidence is already matched or rese.message: This bank statement row does not have enough unmatched amount left: it is already matched or reserved for another payment. Choose a statement row with enough remaining amount.
Bank evidence is already matched or rese.message_id: Sisa nominal baris rekening koran ini tidak mencukupi karena sudah dicocokkan atau dipakai untuk pembayaran lain. Pilih baris rekening koran yang sisanya masih cukup.

Company is inactive.message: This company is inactive, so new records cannot be created for it. Choose an active company.
Company is inactive.message_id: Perusahaan ini tidak aktif, sehingga catatan baru tidak bisa dibuat untuknya. Pilih perusahaan yang aktif.

Return exceeds delivered quantity.message: The returned quantity is more than what was delivered and not yet returned on this order line. Enter a quantity up to the remaining delivered quantity.
Return exceeds delivered quantity.message_id: Jumlah retur melebihi jumlah yang sudah dikirim dan belum diretur pada baris pesanan ini. Masukkan jumlah paling banyak sebesar sisa yang sudah dikirim.

Receipt exceeds ordered quantity.message: The goods receipt was refused: either the purchase order is not open for receiving, or the quantity is more than what is still outstanding on the line. Check that the order is confirmed and enter a quantity up to the remaining ordered quantity.
Receipt exceeds ordered quantity.message_id: Penerimaan barang ditolak: pesanan pembelian belum bisa menerima barang, atau jumlahnya melebihi sisa pesanan pada baris tersebut. Pastikan pesanan sudah dikonfirmasi dan masukkan jumlah paling banyak sebesar sisa yang dipesan.

Invoice must match the fulfilled source.message: An invoice can only be created from a sales order that has been fulfilled, and it must match that order. Fulfil the order first, then create the invoice from it.
Invoice must match the fulfilled source.message_id: Faktur hanya bisa dibuat dari pesanan penjualan yang sudah dipenuhi, dan harus sesuai dengan pesanan tersebut. Penuhi pesanannya terlebih dahulu, lalu buat faktur dari pesanan itu.

Invoice lines must exactly match the unr.message: This sales order has returned items, so an invoice cannot be created directly from it. Create a manual invoice for the items the customer kept.
Invoice lines must exactly match the unr.message_id: Pesanan penjualan ini memiliki barang yang diretur, sehingga faktur tidak bisa dibuat langsung dari pesanan. Buat faktur manual untuk barang yang tetap diterima pelanggan.

Tax code history cannot be deleted.message: A stored tax code cannot be deleted. Withdraw it if it is not confirmed yet, or retire it by setting the last day it applies.
Tax code history cannot be deleted.message_id: Kode pajak yang sudah tersimpan tidak bisa dihapus. Tarik jika belum dikonfirmasi, atau pensiunkan dengan menentukan hari terakhir kode itu berlaku.

A tax code requires an existing native b.message: Tax codes can only be kept in a book that Archava keeps itself (a native book). This book is kept in an external system or was not found. Choose a company whose book is kept in Archava.
A tax code requires an existing native b.message_id: Kode pajak hanya bisa disimpan di pembukuan yang dikelola Archava sendiri (pembukuan native). Pembukuan ini dikelola di sistem eksternal atau tidak ditemukan. Pilih perusahaan yang pembukuannya dikelola di Archava.

A tax rate must be between zero and one.message: The rate must be a fraction from 0 to 1 (0% to 100%) and the base fraction must be above 0 and at most 1, each with a denominator from 1 to 1,000,000. Correct the numbers and try again.
A tax rate must be between zero and one.message_id: Tarif harus berupa pecahan dari 0 sampai 1 (0% sampai 100%) dan pecahan dasar pengenaan harus lebih dari 0 dan paling banyak 1, masing-masing dengan penyebut 1 sampai 1.000.000. Perbaiki angkanya lalu coba lagi.

A book with independent posting needs a.message: This book requires a second person for reviewed entries, so the person who entered a tax code cannot confirm it. Ask another member with tax permissions to confirm it.
A book with independent posting needs a.message_id: Pembukuan ini mewajibkan orang kedua untuk entri yang ditinjau, jadi orang yang memasukkan kode pajak tidak bisa mengonfirmasinya sendiri. Minta anggota lain yang berizin pajak untuk mengonfirmasinya.

A tax code needs an active control accou.message: The control account is inactive, changed since the tax code was entered or reviewed, or does not belong to this book. Refresh the accounts; enter the code with an active account, or withdraw this version and enter a new one.
A tax code needs an active control accou.message_id: Akun kontrol tidak aktif, sudah berubah sejak kode pajak dimasukkan atau ditinjau, atau bukan milik pembukuan ini. Muat ulang daftar akun; masukkan kode dengan akun yang aktif, atau tarik versi ini lalu masukkan versi baru.

A tax control account must be an operati.message: The control account has the wrong type for this tax code. An output (sales) tax code needs a liability account and an input (purchase) tax code needs an asset account, both with the cash role "operating". Choose or create such an account.
A tax control account must be an operati.message_id: Jenis akun kontrol tidak sesuai untuk kode pajak ini. Kode pajak keluaran (penjualan) membutuhkan akun liabilitas dan kode pajak masukan (pembelian) membutuhkan akun aset, keduanya dengan peran kas "operating". Pilih atau buat akun seperti itu.

A tax code keeps its kind across version.message: This code already exists with the other kind. A new version keeps the kind (output or input) of its earlier versions. Use the same kind, or enter the tax under a different code.
A tax code keeps its kind across version.message_id: Kode ini sudah ada dengan jenis yang lain. Versi baru memakai jenis (keluaran atau masukan) yang sama dengan versi sebelumnya. Gunakan jenis yang sama, atau masukkan pajak ini dengan kode lain.

Tax code versions must append in order.message: Another version of this tax code was stored at the same time. Refresh the tax codes and enter the new version again.
Tax code versions must append in order.message_id: Versi lain dari kode pajak ini tersimpan pada saat yang bersamaan. Muat ulang daftar kode pajak dan masukkan versi baru sekali lagi.

Tax code date ranges of one code must no.message: This version would apply on days that another entered or confirmed version of the same code already covers. Retire the confirmed version with a last day before the new first day, withdraw the unconfirmed one, or choose a first day after every existing version ends.
Tax code date ranges of one code must no.message_id: Versi ini akan berlaku pada hari yang sudah dicakup versi lain dari kode yang sama, baik yang sudah dimasukkan maupun dikonfirmasi. Pensiunkan versi yang sudah dikonfirmasi dengan hari terakhir sebelum hari pertama yang baru, tarik versi yang belum dikonfirmasi, atau pilih hari pertama setelah semua versi yang ada berakhir.

A tax code cannot end before it starts.message: The last day is before the first day this tax code version applies. Choose a last day on or after its first day.
A tax code cannot end before it starts.message_id: Hari terakhir lebih awal daripada hari pertama versi kode pajak ini berlaku. Pilih hari terakhir yang sama dengan atau setelah hari pertamanya.

A tax code starts entered, unconfirmed a.message: A new tax code version starts as entered, without a reviewer and without a last day. Enter it with the tax code action, then have it confirmed.
A tax code starts entered, unconfirmed a.message_id: Versi kode pajak yang baru dimulai dengan status dimasukkan, tanpa peninjau dan tanpa hari terakhir. Masukkan dengan tindakan kode pajak, lalu minta konfirmasinya.

A tax code requires a current human memb.message: The person entering or confirming a tax code must be an active member with permission to read and manage tax codes for this book. Ask an administrator for the tax permissions, or have an authorized person do it.
A tax code requires a current human memb.message_id: Orang yang memasukkan atau mengonfirmasi kode pajak harus anggota aktif yang berizin membaca dan mengelola kode pajak untuk pembukuan ini. Minta izin pajak kepada administrator, atau minta orang yang berwenang melakukannya.

Only an entered tax code can be confirme.message: This tax code version is not waiting for confirmation: it was already confirmed, withdrawn or retired. Refresh the tax codes; enter a new version if one is needed.
Only an entered tax code can be confirme.message_id: Versi kode pajak ini tidak sedang menunggu konfirmasi: sudah dikonfirmasi, ditarik, atau dipensiunkan. Muat ulang daftar kode pajak; masukkan versi baru jika diperlukan.

A withdrawn or retired tax code cannot c.message: This tax code version was already withdrawn or retired and cannot be changed again. Enter a new version for later dates.
A withdrawn or retired tax code cannot c.message_id: Versi kode pajak ini sudah ditarik atau dipensiunkan dan tidak bisa diubah lagi. Masukkan versi baru untuk tanggal-tanggal berikutnya.

Retiring a confirmed tax code needs its.message: A confirmed tax code version needs the last day it applies before it can be retired. Enter the last day and try again.
Retiring a confirmed tax code needs its.message_id: Versi kode pajak yang sudah dikonfirmasi membutuhkan hari terakhir berlakunya sebelum bisa dipensiunkan. Isi hari terakhirnya lalu coba lagi.

A stored tax code is immutable; it can o.message: A stored tax code version cannot be edited. Withdraw it if it is not confirmed yet, or retire it by setting its last day, then enter a new version with the corrected values.
A stored tax code is immutable; it can o.message_id: Versi kode pajak yang sudah tersimpan tidak bisa diedit. Tarik jika belum dikonfirmasi, atau pensiunkan dengan menentukan hari terakhirnya, lalu masukkan versi baru dengan nilai yang sudah diperbaiki.

A tax code change must carry the reviewe.message: The tax code was not changed through its own reviewed action, so the change was refused. Use the tax code actions to enter, confirm, withdraw or retire it.
A tax code change must carry the reviewe.message_id: Kode pajak ini tidak diubah melalui tindakan tinjauannya sendiri sehingga perubahannya ditolak. Gunakan tindakan kode pajak untuk memasukkan, mengonfirmasi, menarik, atau memensiunkannya.

A sales order tax code and its price bas.message: A tax code and its price basis go together. When the order names a tax code, say whether the prices include the tax; when it has no tax code, leave the price basis out.
A sales order tax code and its price bas.message_id: Kode pajak dan dasar harganya harus diisi bersama. Jika pesanan memakai kode pajak, tentukan apakah harga sudah termasuk pajak; jika tanpa kode pajak, kosongkan dasar harganya.

A sales order tax code needs a company.message: Only a sales order of a company can carry a tax code. Choose the company first, or create the order without a tax code.
A sales order tax code needs a company.message_id: Hanya pesanan penjualan milik perusahaan yang bisa memakai kode pajak. Pilih perusahaannya dulu, atau buat pesanan tanpa kode pajak.

Sales order tax code is not a tax code o.message: This company's book has no tax code with that code. Choose one of the company's confirmed output tax codes, or enter and confirm the code in Accounting first.
Sales order tax code is not a tax code o.message_id: Pembukuan perusahaan ini tidak punya kode pajak dengan kode tersebut. Pilih salah satu kode pajak keluaran perusahaan yang sudah dikonfirmasi, atau masukkan dan konfirmasi kodenya di Akuntansi terlebih dulu.

A sales order needs an output tax code.message: That tax code is an input code, which is for purchases. Choose an output tax code for a sales order.
A sales order needs an output tax code.message_id: Kode pajak itu adalah kode masukan, yang dipakai untuk pembelian. Pilih kode pajak keluaran untuk pesanan penjualan.

The sales order tax code is entered but.message: That tax code has been entered but a reviewer has not confirmed it yet, so it does not apply. Ask a reviewer to confirm it in Accounting, then create the order again.
The sales order tax code is entered but.message_id: Kode pajak itu sudah dimasukkan tetapi belum dikonfirmasi peninjau, jadi belum berlaku. Minta peninjau mengonfirmasinya di Akuntansi, lalu buat pesanannya lagi.

No confirmed version of the sales order.message: No confirmed version of that tax code applies today: it starts later or has been retired. Choose a tax code that applies today, or enter and confirm a version that does.
No confirmed version of the sales order.message_id: Tidak ada versi terkonfirmasi dari kode pajak itu yang berlaku hari ini: versinya baru mulai nanti atau sudah dipensiunkan. Pilih kode pajak yang berlaku hari ini, atau masukkan dan konfirmasi versi yang berlaku.

No confirmed version of the invoice tax.message: The sales order names a tax code, but no confirmed version of it applies on the invoice date, so the invoice was not created. Enter and confirm a version of the tax code that applies today, then create the invoice again.
No confirmed version of the invoice tax.message_id: Pesanan penjualan ini memakai kode pajak, tetapi tidak ada versi terkonfirmasi yang berlaku pada tanggal faktur, jadi faktur tidak dibuat. Masukkan dan konfirmasi versi kode pajak yang berlaku hari ini, lalu buat fakturnya lagi.

The invoice tax code is not a confirmed.message: This invoice's tax code is not a confirmed output tax code of the book the invoice posts to, so its tax cannot be posted and the invoice was not issued. Check the tax code in Accounting; create the invoice from an order that names a confirmed output tax code of this company's book.
The invoice tax code is not a confirmed.message_id: Kode pajak faktur ini bukan kode pajak keluaran terkonfirmasi pada pembukuan tempat faktur diposting, jadi pajaknya tidak bisa diposting dan faktur tidak diterbitkan. Periksa kode pajaknya di Akuntansi; buat faktur dari pesanan yang memakai kode pajak keluaran terkonfirmasi milik pembukuan perusahaan ini.

The tax control account of the invoice t.message: The control account of this invoice's tax code is inactive, so the invoice's tax cannot be posted and the invoice was not issued. Reactivate the account in Accounting and issue the invoice again. For later invoices you can instead retire this tax code version and enter and confirm a new version with an active account.
The tax control account of the invoice t.message_id: Akun kontrol dari kode pajak faktur ini tidak aktif, jadi pajak faktur tidak bisa diposting dan faktur tidak diterbitkan. Aktifkan kembali akun itu di Akuntansi lalu terbitkan fakturnya lagi. Untuk faktur berikutnya, Anda juga bisa memensiunkan versi kode pajak ini lalu memasukkan dan mengonfirmasi versi baru dengan akun yang aktif.

The tax control account is also an accou.message: The control account of this invoice's tax code is also the receivable, revenue or payment clearing account of the invoice posting policy, so the tax would not be a separate line and the invoice was not issued. Enter and confirm a tax code version with its own liability account.
The tax control account is also an accou.message_id: Akun kontrol dari kode pajak faktur ini juga dipakai sebagai akun piutang, pendapatan, atau kliring pembayaran pada kebijakan posting faktur, sehingga pajak tidak menjadi baris tersendiri dan faktur tidak diterbitkan. Masukkan dan konfirmasi versi kode pajak dengan akun kewajibannya sendiri.

A taxed source draft must use the captur.message: This invoice source carries tax, so its journal posts the tax to the tax control account captured with it, beside the receivable and revenue accounts. Review and select exactly the accounts of the proposed journal at their current revisions, then save the draft again.
A taxed source draft must use the captur.message_id: Sumber faktur ini memuat pajak, jadi jurnalnya memposting pajak ke akun kontrol pajak yang tercatat bersamanya, di samping akun piutang dan pendapatan. Tinjau dan pilih tepat akun-akun pada jurnal yang diusulkan dengan revisi terkininya, lalu simpan drafnya lagi.

A supplier document tax code and its tax.message: A tax code and the supplier's tax amount go together. When the supplier document names a tax code, enter the tax amount printed on it (0 if it prints none); when it has no tax code, leave the tax amount out.
A supplier document tax code and its tax.message_id: Kode pajak dan jumlah pajak pemasok harus diisi bersama. Jika dokumen pemasok memakai kode pajak, isi jumlah pajak yang tercetak di dokumen itu (0 jika tidak ada); jika tanpa kode pajak, kosongkan jumlah pajaknya.

Supplier document tax code is not a tax.message: This company's book has no tax code with that code. Choose one of the company's confirmed input tax codes, or enter and confirm the code in Accounting first.
Supplier document tax code is not a tax.message_id: Pembukuan perusahaan ini tidak punya kode pajak dengan kode itu. Pilih salah satu kode pajak masukan perusahaan yang sudah dikonfirmasi, atau masukkan dan konfirmasi kodenya di Akuntansi lebih dulu.

A supplier document needs an input tax c.message: That tax code is an output code, which is for sales. Choose an input tax code for a supplier document.
A supplier document needs an input tax c.message_id: Kode pajak itu adalah kode keluaran, yang dipakai untuk penjualan. Pilih kode pajak masukan untuk dokumen pemasok.

The supplier document tax code is entere.message: That tax code has been entered but a reviewer has not confirmed it yet, so it does not apply. Ask a reviewer to confirm it in Accounting, then save the supplier document again.
The supplier document tax code is entere.message_id: Kode pajak itu sudah dimasukkan tetapi belum dikonfirmasi peninjau, jadi belum berlaku. Minta peninjau mengonfirmasinya di Akuntansi, lalu simpan dokumen pemasoknya lagi.

No confirmed version of the supplier doc.message: No confirmed version of that tax code applies on the date of the supplier document: it starts later or was retired before that date. Check the document date, choose a tax code that applies on it, or enter and confirm a version that does.
No confirmed version of the supplier doc.message_id: Tidak ada versi terkonfirmasi dari kode pajak itu yang berlaku pada tanggal dokumen pemasok: versinya baru mulai setelahnya atau sudah dipensiunkan sebelum tanggal itu. Periksa tanggal dokumen, pilih kode pajak yang berlaku pada tanggal itu, atau masukkan dan konfirmasi versi yang berlaku.

Supplier document tax snapshot differs f.message: The tax code details stored with this supplier document are not those of the tax code version that applies on its date, so the document was not saved. Refresh the supplier documents and save the claim again.
Supplier document tax snapshot differs f.message_id: Rincian kode pajak yang disimpan bersama dokumen pemasok ini tidak sama dengan versi kode pajak yang berlaku pada tanggalnya, jadi dokumen tidak disimpan. Muat ulang dokumen pemasok lalu simpan klaimnya lagi.

A supplier document tax amount cannot be.message: The tax amount is larger than the goods total of the supplier document, or negative. Enter the tax amount printed on the supplier's document; it cannot be more than the goods total.
A supplier document tax amount cannot be.message_id: Jumlah pajak lebih besar daripada total barang pada dokumen pemasok, atau negatif. Isi jumlah pajak yang tercetak di dokumen pemasok; jumlahnya tidak boleh melebihi total barang.

Supplier document computed tax must foll.message: The tax calculated for this supplier document does not follow its tax code, so the document was not saved. Refresh the supplier documents and save the claim again; the calculated tax is worked out by Archava and is not entered.
Supplier document computed tax must foll.message_id: Pajak hasil hitung untuk dokumen pemasok ini tidak mengikuti kode pajaknya, jadi dokumen tidak disimpan. Muat ulang dokumen pemasok lalu simpan klaimnya lagi; pajak hasil hitung dihitung oleh Archava dan tidak diisi.

Supplier document tax changes only with.message: The tax of a supplier claim cannot change while it is checked, matched or voided. Void the claim if it is matched, then record a corrected claim version with the new tax code or tax amount.
Supplier document tax changes only with.message_id: Pajak pada klaim pemasok tidak bisa berubah saat klaim diperiksa, dicocokkan, atau dibatalkan. Batalkan klaim jika sudah cocok, lalu catat versi klaim koreksi dengan kode pajak atau jumlah pajak yang baru.

Purchase source tax differs from the tax.message: The tax of this purchase source is not the tax stored on its supplier document, so it was not recorded. Purchase sources are captured by Archava from the matched supplier document; match or void the document through Purchasing instead.
Purchase source tax differs from the tax.message_id: Pajak pada sumber pembelian ini tidak sama dengan pajak yang tersimpan di dokumen pemasoknya, jadi tidak dicatat. Sumber pembelian direkam oleh Archava dari dokumen pemasok yang sudah cocok; cocokkan atau batalkan dokumennya lewat Pembelian.

The supplier document tax code is not a.message: This supplier document's tax code is not a confirmed input tax code of the book the bill posts to, so its tax cannot be posted and the claim was not matched. Check the tax code in Accounting; record a corrected claim version that names a confirmed input tax code of this company's book.
The supplier document tax code is not a.message_id: Kode pajak dokumen pemasok ini bukan kode pajak masukan terkonfirmasi pada pembukuan tempat tagihan diposting, jadi pajaknya tidak bisa diposting dan klaim tidak dicocokkan. Periksa kode pajaknya di Akuntansi; catat versi klaim koreksi yang memakai kode pajak masukan terkonfirmasi milik pembukuan perusahaan ini.

The tax control account of the supplier.message: The control account of this supplier document's tax code is inactive, so the bill's tax cannot be posted and the claim was not matched. Reactivate the account in Accounting and check the claim again. For later documents you can instead retire this tax code version and enter and confirm a new version with an active account.
The tax control account of the supplier.message_id: Akun kontrol dari kode pajak dokumen pemasok ini tidak aktif, jadi pajak tagihan tidak bisa diposting dan klaim tidak dicocokkan. Aktifkan kembali akun itu di Akuntansi lalu periksa klaimnya lagi. Untuk dokumen berikutnya, Anda juga bisa memensiunkan versi kode pajak ini lalu memasukkan dan mengonfirmasi versi baru dengan akun yang aktif.

The tax control account is also an accou.message: The control account of this supplier document's tax code is also the inventory, goods received not invoiced, payable or landed fee account of the purchase posting policy of its order, so the tax would not be a separate line and the claim was not matched. Enter and confirm a tax code version with its own asset account, then record a corrected claim version.
The tax control account is also an accou.message_id: Akun kontrol dari kode pajak dokumen pemasok ini juga dipakai sebagai akun persediaan, barang diterima belum ditagih, utang, atau biaya perolehan pada kebijakan posting pembelian pesanannya, sehingga pajak tidak menjadi baris tersendiri dan klaim tidak dicocokkan. Masukkan dan konfirmasi versi kode pajak dengan akun asetnya sendiri, lalu catat versi klaim koreksi.

A purchase void retains the tax control.message: The void of a supplier bill uses the tax control account of the bill it reverses, and this one names another, so it was not recorded. Void the supplier document through Purchasing; Archava captures the void with the bill's account.
A purchase void retains the tax control.message_id: Pembatalan tagihan pemasok memakai akun kontrol pajak dari tagihan yang dibatalkannya, sedangkan yang ini menyebut akun lain, jadi tidak dicatat. Batalkan dokumen pemasok lewat Pembelian; Archava merekam pembatalannya dengan akun tagihan itu.

Only a taxed invoice can carry a tax inv.message: This invoice carries no tax, so it cannot be given a tax invoice reference. Record the reference on the taxed invoice it belongs to.
Only a taxed invoice can carry a tax inv.message_id: Faktur ini tidak memuat pajak, jadi tidak bisa diberi nomor referensi faktur pajak. Catat referensi itu pada faktur berpajak yang bersangkutan.

A tax invoice reference can be recorded.message: A tax invoice reference can be recorded only on an issued or settled invoice. Issue the draft first; a voided invoice takes no reference.
A tax invoice reference can be recorded.message_id: Referensi faktur pajak hanya bisa dicatat pada faktur yang sudah diterbitkan atau lunas. Terbitkan dulu drafnya; faktur yang dibatalkan tidak menerima referensi.

The invoice already has a tax invoice re.message: This invoice already has a tax invoice reference. Use "Replace the tax invoice reference" with a reason to change it; the earlier value stays in the audit trail.
The invoice already has a tax invoice re.message_id: Faktur ini sudah punya referensi faktur pajak. Gunakan "Ganti referensi faktur pajak" dengan alasan untuk mengubahnya; nilai sebelumnya tetap ada di jejak audit.

The invoice has no tax invoice reference.message: This invoice has no tax invoice reference to replace. Record the reference first.
The invoice has no tax invoice reference.message_id: Faktur ini belum punya referensi faktur pajak untuk diganti. Catat dulu referensinya.

A company registered for tax needs a tax.message: A company can be marked as registered for tax only while its tax id is digits with spaces, dots, slashes or hyphens. Correct the tax id on the source organization, refresh the company, then set the registration.
A company registered for tax needs a tax.message_id: Perusahaan hanya bisa ditandai terdaftar pajak selama nomor pajaknya berupa angka dengan spasi, titik, garis miring atau tanda hubung. Perbaiki nomor pajak pada organisasi sumber, segarkan perusahaan, lalu atur pendaftarannya.

A taxed purchase draft must use the capt.message: This supplier bill source carries tax, so its journal posts the tax to the tax control account captured with it, beside the goods received not invoiced and payable accounts. Review and select exactly the accounts of the proposed journal at their current revisions, then save the draft again.
A taxed purchase draft must use the capt.message_id: Sumber tagihan pemasok ini memuat pajak, jadi jurnalnya memposting pajak ke akun kontrol pajak yang tercatat bersamanya, di samping akun barang diterima belum ditagih dan akun utang. Tinjau dan pilih tepat akun-akun pada jurnal yang diusulkan dengan revisi terkininya, lalu simpan drafnya lagi.
